tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
for r in range(6,14):
    ws.cell(r,5).value = '=IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH(\"deposit\",B{0})),\"Revenue\",IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH(\"withdrawal\",B{0})),\"Expenses\",\"\"))'.format(r)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
